_comment: DB-ESDK TestServer commons server-config.json (design 'Server Configuration'):
product + one Configuration_Entry per language. The Feature_Catalog lives in
the sibling feature-set.json and the bug ledger in bug-list.json (the doc's
three-file layout) — the only supported configuration format. The shared
orchestrator's ConfigurationLoader loads this trio (server-config.json +
feature-set.json + bug-list.json) and fails if server-config.json is absent.
The per-language SERVERS live in the DB-ESDK product repo
(aws-database-encryption-sdk-dynamodb) under test-server/<lang>-v<major>-server/;
the test cases + shared harness (model/tests/orchestrator/tests-support/client-java)
stay in commons. Each entry's serverLocation + libraryRepository therefore point
at the product repo, and configPath names the DIRECTORY holding the per-server trio
(server-config.json/feature-config.json/bug-config.json) co-located with the server.
EXCEPTION — the native-Java server: the 'java-native' entry's serverLocation +
libraryRepository point at the aws-crypto-tools-java repo (dbesdk/test-server/server),
the home of the native (non-Dafny) Java DB-ESDK. It uses a DISTINCT language token
('java-native', not 'java') because the orchestrator keys every per-language
component (ComponentId.server:<lang>/library:<lang>, the launcher map, the effective-
entry map) by language alone, so it must not collide with the Dafny 'java' entry; the
token is wired to JavaLaunchPlan in TestServerOrchestratorMain, exactly as 'rust-dafny'
reuses RustLaunchPlan.
